mapper.sql: select b.id, b.shop_code, b.bomcode as bom_code, b.productcode as product_code, b.productname as product_name, b.spec, b.unit, b.status, b.createuser as create_user, b.createtime as create_time, b.updateuser as update_user, b.updatetime as update_time, b.remark, (select count(*) from sdsshop.u_p_bomdetail d where d.shop_code = b.shop_code and d.bomcode = b.bomcode) as item_count from sdsshop.u_p_bom b
mapper.select: select productcode from sdsshop.u_p_bom where shop_code = #{shopCode} order by productcode
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_p_bom set productname = #{productName}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and bomcode = #{bomCode}
mapper.delete: delete from sdsshop.u_p_bom where shop_code = #{shopCode} and bomcode = #{bomCode}
